purpose: Physically skip the capability-cake subgraph during English-core continuation instead of computing its residual and multiplying the result by zero.

triggering_profile.finding: Continuation semantics require the frozen English core, but the prior scalar-zero schedule still executed every task-cake operator. Conditional graph execution can improve speed and physical sparsity simultaneously.

single_allowed_graph_change.construction: Move the exact task-cake residual nodes and unchanged residual add into the true branch of one ONNX If. The false branch returns the identical core hidden state through Identity.
single_allowed_graph_change.condition: False for prompt-scan calls, true for the final prompt/first-output decision, false for every continuation decode step.
single_allowed_graph_change.outer_graph: The transformer, classifier, route, output projection, cache, output names, canonical ABI state, and quantized initializers remain unchanged.

equivalence_gates: active true branch logits and ABI state equal the source graph with the cake active
false branch logits and ABI state equal an independently bypassed core reference
route, task scores, and every cache tensor remain exact in both branches
all previously passed native functional and general quality gates pass on the conditional artifact
physical_gate: An ONNX Runtime operator trace must show task-cake branch operators execute exactly once per generated sequence and zero times during continuation.
speed_gate: The unchanged 40-observation sustained benchmark must pass every gate, including at least 95 percent sealed-parent throughput, at least 2x Qwen median, and paired bootstrap lower bound at least 2x.
failure_rule: If equivalence, quality, physical execution, or speed fails, preserve and close this architecture. Do not sweep active decode steps.
